request_text: Create a workflow that runs whenever a new support email arrives. If the subject contains 'refund', create a ticket in the Returns queue and assign it to the Billing team.
workflow_goal: Route support emails about refunds into the Returns queue and assign the resulting tickets to the Billing team.

workflow_objects.object_role: Starts the workflow when a support email arrives.
Allows the ticket creation and assignment steps to run only when the email subject contains the specified term.
Creates a ticket for a matching support email.
Assigns the created ticket to the requested team.
